# pi4-platd fixture

P8b fixture for the multi-window platform launch. The initfs installs `raven-init` (svcd),
`devd`, `platd` and a `plat:` client. The driver table selects three MMIO windows with repeated
`bar=0/1/2` selectors (the table parser splits `args` on commas, so `mmio=0,1,2` is not used there)
and one DMA buffer; devd creates them in declaration order (BAR slots 3/4/5, DMA slot 6). The
named `mailbox=3:64`, `gpio=4:180`, `rng=5:40` and `dma=6:256` tokens are what the platd hardware
backend would consume; the qtest selects `fake` so it exercises the launch and scheme without
touching device registers.

`tests/fixtures/pi4-platd/pi4-platd.dtb.hex` is generated by `generate.py`: one platform node
with three page-sized `reg` windows. The qtest runs on x86_64 and starts the client after
`scheme:plat`; it exercises `plat:model`, `plat:mac`, `plat:clock/12`, `plat:power/0`, GPIO
claim/conflict/config/release and RNG reads. The hardware capability plan is validated by
`cargo nextest run -p raven-platd`; this is a launch/scheme test, not a Pi 4 register test.
